Use these guides when you need to understand a method or change the default
workflow. For a first run, follow [Get started](documentation.html).

## Methods and interpretation

- [Statistical analysis](statistical-analysis.html): gene-set tests, category
  inference and the limits of comparisons.
- [How lisaR works](how-lisar-works.html): dictionaries, categories and resources.
- [Category guide](semantic-category-guide.html): plot variants and their meaning.
- [Dictionary construction](dictionary-construction.html): how the saved
  assignments were produced.

## Inputs and configuration

- [Extended R workflow](getting-started.html): input objects, multiple DE
  analyses, contrasts and report options.
- [Prepare DE inputs](preparing-de-inputs.html): input conventions and provenance.
- [Resources and provenance](resources-and-provenance.html): membership resources
  and their registration.
- [Custom dictionaries](custom-dictionaries-and-supercategories.html): your own
  categories and supercategories.
- [Installation details](advanced-installation.html): optional dependencies,
  local environments and installation troubleshooting.

## Reports and worked examples

- [Reports and figures](scientific-report.html): additional products and saved
  result workflows.
- [Shiny app](shiny-app.html): explore saved results and generate selected figures.
- [Riaz PRE and ON](riaz-gse91061-worked-example.html): the complete prepared study.
- [CPTAC proteomics](cptac-ccrcc-proteomics.html): a proteomic example.
- [Synthetic example](quick-start.html): a self-contained offline demonstration.
